location.description: The location filter, when one was given.

assigned_demand.description: The demand the plan was evaluated against (see demand_source), in orders.

demand_source.description: Additive (docs/adr/0004). "request": assigned_demand was stated by the caller (also every plan created before demand ingestion); "orders": it was omitted and defaulted from the order-management read model.

path_capacity.description: Normalized path capacity, ORDER per HOUR.

capacity_over_window.description: path_capacity x window hours, in orders.

bottleneck_constraint.description: Additive. The constraint type binding the bottleneck step (e.g. LABOR or STATION); empty for plans created before it was recorded.

warnings.description: Additive. Composition warnings raised when the plan was created (never null).

400.description: limit is not a positive integer (malformed-limit).
